event: For the listed OpenAI–Hugging Face intrusion, OpenAI introduced GPT‑6 Cyber, a cybersecurity model trained to find and validate vulnerabilities while staying within researchers’ scope. OpenAI said one pre-deployment alignment test, ExploitGym Honeypot, was informed by the Hugging Face incident; an OpenAI researcher said training included a simulation intended to mimic it. (OpenAI, 2026-11-05.)
